entries.2cb25433923f089f: Yosuke Okada, Representative Director and CEO, established ABEJA, Inc. in September 2012 in Higashi, Shibuya Ward, Tokyo, with stated capital of ¥1,000 thousand, prompted by deep learning, a technological innovation in the field of machine learning announced in 2012. In June 2013, it absorbed and merged Idotai Fuzui Joho Hyoji Sochi Co., Ltd. The head office location subsequently moved repeatedly: to Minami-Azabu, Minato Ward in October 2012, to Roppongi in August 2014, to Toranomon in March 2016, to Shirokane in March 2018, to Kita-Aoyama in September 2020, and to Mita (the current location) in September 2022. entries.4b76b0cd9145c1eb: Under the corporate philosophy 'Implementing a Richer World,' the company develops, introduces and operates the ABEJA Platform, the foundation system for supporting the introduction of AI into mission-critical operations. The company has a single segment, the digital platform business. Built around the ABEJA Platform, the company runs its business in two areas: the Transformation Area, which provides AI introduction support and related services, and the Operation Area, which handles subsequent operations through collaboration between people and AI. Its business model is close to that of an EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Service). Drawing on know-how from supporting AI introduction for more than 300 companies across a wide range of industries and business types, it provides integrated support to match customer needs, from consulting through to operations on the ABEJA Platform. Operating results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were revenue of ¥3,585,409 thousand (up 29.6% year on year), operating profit of ¥445,886 thousand (up 53.6%), ordinary profit of ¥451,978 thousand (up 57.7%) and net income of ¥448,268 thousand (up 105.0%), with higher revenue and higher profit. Its main customers are Sakura Internet Inc. (17.2% of total sales) and SOMPO Holdings, Inc. (¥461,580 thousand, 12.9%).

entries.f2507eaf8c79fbce: This domain handles operation through collaboration between people and AI on ABEJA Platform, and is positioned as the operation phase. Its main revenue is stock-type recurring revenue, and it currently covers multiple industries including retail, real estate, manufacturing and finance. As a specific example, it provides "ABEJA Insight for Retail," built on ABEJA Platform, mainly to the retail industry; through devices such as cameras installed in stores, it analyzes consumer flow lines and estimates age and gender, visualizing and quantifying consumer behavior from store entry to purchase, which leads to understanding store issues and improving operations. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were 126.7% of the same period of the previous year, and 23.4% of the total.

entries.fc0de5e405c47889: This domain provides support for introducing ABEJA Platform in response to customer needs and its peripheral services, and is positioned as the system-building and construction phase. Because system building and construction proceed in stages, much of the revenue comes from flow-type (per-engagement) contracts; however, as it is a planned process over a long period, the proportion of repeat customers is high, and the share of revenue from repeat enterprise customers is 88.8% (fiscal year ended August 2025). It provides hands-on support from formulating and sharing management-level and company-wide visions, through planning to realize those visions, to introducing ABEJA Platform in line with business processes, and also promotes the development of in-house digital talent at customer companies through AI training and other programs. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were 130.5% of the same period of the previous year, and 76.6% of the total.
